Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q1 2019 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of BLK.
Our cloud segment grew 6% year-over-year, driven by strong enterprise demand.
Revenue guidance of $44.7 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q1 2019.
Our cloud segment grew 6% year-over-year, driven by strong enterprise demand.
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 152 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.

Analyst - First question:
Can you clarify whether the margin expansion is sustainable into next year given rising input costs?
Thank you for the question. Our gross margin expanded by 152 basis points to 70.7%, reflecting improved operational efficiency.
Second question - Analyst:
Are you seeing any signs of demand elasticity in your enterprise segment?
We believe the pipeline is strong, but conversion timing remains uncertain given customer budget cycles.
